purpose: Development-only controlled removal of noise components on identical routed circuits.
cohort: All Babai-nonoptimal members of the 64 development cases. Remaining hybrid outputs are exactly optimal because Babai is retained. No standalone full-cohort claim.
channel_definition: gate_channels includes calibrated depolarizing and gate-duration T1/T2; idle_only is explicit scheduled-delay relaxation; readout is the asymmetric independent channel. Interactions between channels are possible.
numerical_amendment: Disable Aer output truncation before retrying: default 1e-10 threshold lost 2.41456e-6 normalization mass in one trajectory of the first noise circuit; preserve assertion and failed run.
